Title: Generally available: Azure Site Recovery update rollup 61 - March 2022

Body.Content:
This update provides the following improvements for the latest version of Azure Site Recovery components.

  • Mobility Service
    • Added support for additional kernel list for Debian 10 and Ubuntu 20.04 Linux distros.
    • Added support for thin-provisioned logical volume management (LVM) volumes. 
  • Microsoft Azure Site Recovery (Service)
    • Integration of on-demand capacity reservation with Site Recovery for public preview is now live.
  • Microsoft Azure Site Recovery (Portal)
    • Integration of on-demand capacity reservation with Site Recovery for public preview is now live.

This update also provides bug fixes.

Learn more about the issues fixed and get the download links.
